name: 22801 · Harrisonburg, VA
findings: ZIP 22801 (Harrisonburg) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22801 (Harrisonburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
